source.title: A merchant can provision a server once and read its health without receiving credentials
A sender reaches verified state and retirement preserves its history and other senders on that number
Invalid template submissions are rejected before any provider creation attempt
Concurrent binding edits have one winner and preserve the selected language and parameter mapping
Two numbers on one owned WhatsApp account share discovered languages without exposing another merchant’s templates
A failed discovery page never publishes a partial template list
An ambiguous template submission returns its provider identity without posting twice
Signed status hints invalidate discovery while Meta decides the outcome of an already bound template send
Rejected templates expose the provider reason while an invalid signature cannot invalidate the cache
A missed callback is repaired when the bounded template cache expires
A provider outage returns a synchronous failure and the next refresh can recover
A merchant deletes only its selected template language while foreign requests have no provider effect
An accepted pending deletion preserves binding history but cannot be bound or sent as an approved template
A rejected deletion remains visible and retry targets the same exact template
An uncertain deletion is reported as unknown and fresh discovery prevents a blind repeat
Invalid server configuration and foreign provisioning create no durable row
A rejected provider credential leaves its asynchronously created sender failed and unverified
An unverified phone with no registration PIN cannot become a verified sender
Retirement refuses new sends, preserves prior message reads and leaves its sibling usable
A scoped template wins first and its removal exposes only an explicitly granted global fallback
A concurrent binding winner remains durable after the losing and foreign edits
A MARKETING submission returns inline identity and complete redacted provider facts with bounded freshness
A binding preserves HEADER BODY and dynamic URL parameter order independently of metadata property order
Concurrent identical submissions share one identity while another language remains independent
A failed create reports an unknown outcome and a same-name retry recovers after the provider returns
Missing provider templates cannot be bound and an unconfigured alias cannot reach the provider
One new merchant server and sender complete creation discovery approval and binding with the same identities
Catalog pagination visits every variant and rejects malformed filter and obsolete generation cursors
Unsupported bodies parameters examples and buttons are rejected before template creation
Real health sweeps report fresh facts, retain failed observations and never freshen empty responses
Bird selects the owned scoped template before a granted global template and preserves its native payload
Bird falls back to the explicitly granted global template when the merchant has no scoped row
A revoked global template grant and a foreign Bird sender are refused before provider effects
The local merchant connection matches the real Meta phone and template account
Real Meta creates one permitted template and CNS resolves the duplicate to the same identity
A genuine signed approval callback and current Meta state agree with CNS discovery
Real Meta accepts deletion of this attempts exact disposable template without deleting its namesake variant
Primary capability and machine-grant changes fence the next admitted request
Machine proof cannot widen its exact entity grants or operation capabilities
Foreign template creation, refresh and binding attempts have no provider effects
Every pooled sender, server and template grant must remain live for an exact tenant send
An owner and an exact machine grant can read a template list while a service key alone cannot
A different merchant using the same service key cannot read or mutate the owner’s template list
Revoked Merchant Pass proof is refused within the bounded admission cache window
Expired Merchant Pass proof stops authorizing within the admission cache lifetime
